core_principles: Mobile-First & Touch-Friendly: All tap targets > 44px. Bottom navigation for primary flows.
Community Centric: Warm tones, inviting typography, focus on readability.
Utility & Safety: High contrast for panic/alert features. Clear hierarchy.
Spanish-First: Interface terminology must be natural for Latin American users.

usage_rules.primary_action: bg-primary-700 hover:bg-primary-900 text-white rounded-full shadow-lg hover:shadow-xl transition-all

layout_strategy.container: max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen bg-stone-50 shadow-2xl relative pb-24 md:pb-0 md:max-w-none md:grid md:grid-cols-[280px_1fr]

navigation.mobile: Fixed bottom bar, h-16 bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-lg border-t border-stone-200 flex justify-around items-center z-50
navigation.desktop: Sidebar fixed left, h-screen bg-primary-900 text-white p-6 hidden md:flex flex-col

cards.base: bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-stone-100 overflow-hidden hover:shadow-md transition-shadow duration-200
cards.feed_item: bg-white rounded-2xl p-5 shadow-sm border border-stone-100 mb-4

buttons.primary: h-12 px-6 bg-primary-700 text-white font-semibold rounded-full hover:bg-primary-800 transition-colors flex items-center justify-center gap-2 w-full md:w-auto shadow-sm
buttons.panic: h-16 w-16 rounded-full bg-red-600 text-white shadow-xl shadow-red-200 flex items-center justify-center fixed bottom-20 right-4 z-40 active:scale-90 transition-transform md:static md:w-full md:h-12 md:rounded-xl
buttons.ghost: h-10 px-4 text-stone-600 hover:bg-stone-100 rounded-lg font-medium transition-colors

inputs.base: h-12 px-4 bg-stone-50 border border-stone-200 rounded-xl focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary-500/20 focus:border-primary-500 outline-none w-full transition-all text-stone-900 placeholder:text-stone-400

images.description: Modern apartment facade, used for login screen background with overlay
Welcome sign for home feed header
Keys in hand for lost and found demo

motion.page_transition: initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} exit={{ opacity: 0 }} transition={{ duration: 0.3 }}

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. IMPLEMENTATION: Build components first in /components/ui, then pages.
2. LANGUAGE: Ensure ALL user-facing text is in Spanish (es-419).
3. PWA FEEL: Use 'fixed bottom-0' for navigation on mobile. Ensure 'safe-area-inset-bottom' support.
4. PANIC BUTTON: This is a critical feature. Make it accessible but prevent accidental clicks (e.g., long press or confirm modal). For this MVP, use a distinct red FAB.
5. MOCK DATA: Create realistic Latin American mock data (Names: Juan Pérez, María González. Currency: $ or Bs depending on context, default to generic $).
6. NOTIFICATIONS: Use 'sonner' for toast notifications (e.g., 'Reporte enviado con éxito').
7. IMAGES: Use the provided Unsplash URLs for demo content.
9. RESPONSIVENESS: Mobile view is priority. Desktop view should use a sidebar layout for Admin, but Vecino view can remain centered mobile-app style on desktop.
universal_guidelines: Do not use generic gradients. Use flat colors or subtle noise textures.
Use data-testid for all interactive elements.
